review.notes: No hard-rule breach (home_furnishing, cotton not glass, le_500g, Rs 999 above floor). On 2026-11-25 I found no embroidered tea cosy at or below Rs 450 on Amazon.in, Flipkart or Meesho, so it is not undercut on present evidence, and the margin passes on the website (48.94% at Rs 275, 40.71% at Rs 350). But the Rs 275 IndiaMART figure comes only from a search snippet with no MOQ and no hand/machine statement. Rs 1,299-1,449 retail rests on one D2C seller (Gyawun) and there is no marketplace demand evidence. So before any sample spend we need a written quote (MOQ, hand vs machine chain-stitch, packed weight, single-piece dispatch) and a stated cosy size.

review.supplier_cost_check: 2026-11-25 WebSearch snippet of https://m.indiamart.com/impcat/tea-cozy.html: seller 'Fine Art Gallery', Srinagar (GST, 9 yrs), 'Multicolour Crewel Tea Cozy' Rs 275/Piece, dusoot cotton. MOQ NOT shown, and hand crewel vs machine chain-stitch NOT stated. The page could not be fetched (m.indiamart.com unreachable from this session). For comparison, Srinagar cotton crewel fabric lists at Rs 850/metre (https://m.indiamart.com/impcat/crewel-fabric.html), and a 12 x 14 in two-sided cosy uses roughly 0.25-0.3 m, about Rs 210-255 of fabric alone. So Rs 275 for a finished, lined cosy is plausible only for machine (Amritsar-type) chain-stitch on standard fabric. That is my inference, not supplier evidence. recommend.py evaluate() at Rs 999: Rs 275 cost gives 48.94%, expected Rs 428.35; Rs 350 gives 40.71%, Rs 356.35; Rs 450 gives 29.74% FAIL. At Rs 275 cost and Rs 799 price: 37.30%, Rs 261.12.
review.complaint_patterns: 2026-11-25: no India- or crewel-specific tea cosy complaint data found. Generic tea cosy reviews show size mismatch as the main complaint: too large or too small for the teapot, letting heat escape (https://www.wayfair.ie/kitchenware-tableware/pdp/lily-manor-lassen-tea-cosy-caut1105.html, https://www.desertcart.co/products/61348141, https://www.ebay.co.uk/p/1238685674). Other complaints: thin stuffing and poor heat retention (desertcart), lining splitting and going lumpy after a 20-degree wash (https://www.wayfair.co.uk/kitchenware-tableware/pdp/lily-manor-lagunitas-strawberry-thief-tea-cosy-caut1071.html), and a 'faulty' embroidered cosy (https://Notonthehighstreet.Com/potteaskitchentextiles/product/time-for-tea-embroidered-tea-cosy). Mitigation: state inner dimensions and a teapot-capacity fit guide, confirm padding/lining, and give dry-clean or hand-wash care.
